tool.name: add_entity_relation
tool.title: Add Entity Relation
tool.description: Add a relation between existing entities or add a hashtag to your own post.

tool.name: compare_topics
tool.title: Compare Topics
tool.description: Compare data point statistics side-by-side for two topics (cards, bank accounts, etc.). Useful for answering questions like "which card has a better approval rate?"

topic_id_a.description: UUID or slug of the first topic to compare

topic_id_b.description: UUID or slug of the second topic to compare

vertical.description: Optionally filter to a specific data point vertical

tool.name: get_domain_ratings
tool.title: Get Domain Ratings
tool.description: Look up trust signals for a linked source. Provide exactly one of url or hostname. Returns hostname/domain trust votes and, when a URL maps to an RSS source, the associated source topic ratings and metrics.

hostname.description: A bare hostname/domain to inspect, such as example.com

tool.name: get_my_cards
tool.title: Get My Cards
tool.description: List the current user's wallet cards.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous list page

limit.description: Number of cards to return, from 1 to 100

tool.name: get_my_point_valuations
tool.title: Get My Point Valuations
tool.description: List the current user's rewards program point valuations.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page

limit.description: Number of valuations to return, from 1 to 100

tool.name: get_my_profile
tool.title: Get My Profile
tool.description: Get the current user's wallet profile including their cards, point valuations, rewards program statuses, and financial profile (credit score range, income range).

cards_after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous cards page

cards_limit.description: Number of cards to return, from 1 to 100

point_valuations_after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous point valuations page

point_valuations_limit.description: Number of point valuations to return, from 1 to 100

rewards_program_statuses_after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous rewards program statuses page

rewards_program_statuses_limit.description: Number of rewards program statuses to return, from 1 to 100

tool.name: get_my_rewards_statuses
tool.title: Get My Rewards Statuses
tool.description: List the current user's rewards program statuses.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous status page

limit.description: Number of statuses to return, from 1 to 100

tool.name: get_my_spending
tool.title: Get My Spending
tool.description: List the current user's spending categories.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the prior list page

tool.name: get_recommended_topics
tool.title: Get Recommended Topics
tool.description: Get personalized topic recommendations based on the current user's activity, including positive post choices, followed feeds, and views. Use this for questions like 'what cards should I look into?' or 'what topics might interest me?'. Returns topic IDs with recommendation scores. Use get_topic_details for full card information.

limit.description: Maximum number of recommendations to return (1-25). Defaults to 10.

tool.name: get_referral_links
tool.title: Get Referral Links
tool.description: Get prioritized referral links for a topic. Ranks links by social connections: mutual follows, follows, referrers, positive-choice authors, then everyone else.

topic_id.description: The topic identifier (UUID or slug) to look up referral links for. Can be a referral program topic or any topic with a linked referral program.

tool.name: get_topic_details
tool.title: Get Topic Details
tool.description: Get detailed information about a topic (card, bank account, rewards program, etc.). For cards, returns the annual fee, issuing bank, and card brand. For rewards programs, returns the parent company. Always includes the full description and aliases. Set hierarchy to also get parent topics (the organization that issues a card) and/or child topics (all cards a bank issues, all tiers in a rewards program); children come one page at a time, so pass children_page_info.end_cursor as children_after for the next page.

topic_id.description: The topic UUID or slug to retrieve details for

hierarchy.description: Also return related topics. "parents" = what this topic belongs to (for example the bank that issues a card), "children" = what belongs to this topic (for example every card a bank issues), "both" = each. Omit for no related topics.

children_after.description: Cursor from a previous result children_page_info.end_cursor, for the next page of children. Only used when hierarchy is "children" or "both".

children_limit.description: Maximum number of children per page. Defaults to 25; values over 100 are clamped to 100. Only used when hierarchy is "children" or "both".

tool.name: get_topic_insights
tool.title: Get Topic Insights
tool.description: Get aggregate data point statistics for a topic (card, bank account, etc.). Returns approval rate, median credit limit, and credit score distribution.

topic_id.description: The topic UUID or slug to aggregate data points for

vertical.description: Optionally filter to a specific data point vertical

tool.name: get_topic_metrics
tool.title: Get Topic Metrics
tool.description: Get engagement metrics for a topic: post counts by type (discussions, reviews, data points, news), follower count, and star rating distribution. Useful for gauging how active and well-reviewed a card or product is.

topic_id.description: The topic UUID or slug to retrieve metrics for

tool.name: get_trending_posts
tool.title: Get Trending Posts
tool.description: Get posts that are trending based on time-decay voting. Useful for "what discussions are hot this week?" or "what are the most popular reviews for this card?". Optionally filter by post type or topic. Returns page_info.end_cursor; pass it as after to get the next page.

time_range.description: Time window for trending calculation. Defaults to "week".

post_type.description: Optionally filter to a specific post type.

topic_id.description: Optionally filter to posts tagged with a specific topic, by UUID or slug.

after.description: Cursor from a previous result page_info.end_cursor, for the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 20; values over 100 are clamped to 100.

tool.name: get_trending_topics
tool.title: Get Trending Topics
tool.description: Get topics (cards, bank accounts, rewards programs, etc.) that are trending based on recent post and news activity. Useful for answering "what credit cards are popular right now?" or "what topics are being discussed?". Returns topic IDs with trending scores — use get_topic_details to get full card information. Returns page_info.end_cursor; pass it as after to get the next page.

time_range.description: Time window for trending calculation. Defaults to "week".

after.description: Cursor from a previous result page_info.end_cursor, for the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 20; values over 100 are clamped to 100.

tool.name: get_wikipedia_summary
tool.title: Get Wikipedia Summary
tool.description: Gets detailed summary information for a Wikipedia article by title. Returns the full Wikipedia page data including description, extract, URL, and thumbnail. Use this after searching to get complete details about a specific article.

title.description: The exact Wikipedia article title (e.g., "Artificial intelligence")

tool.name: manage_my_cards
tool.title: Manage My Cards
tool.description: Manage the current user's wallet cards: add, update, or remove them. List them with get_my_cards.

id.description: Required for update and remove actions.

card_id.description: The topic UUID of the card to add (required for action=add)

opened_on.description: Date the card was opened in YYYY-MM-DD format

closed_on.description: Date the card was closed in YYYY-MM-DD format

credit_limit.description: Credit limit in integer minor units paired with its currency

is_authorized_user.description: Whether the user is an authorized user on this card

authorized_user_of_id.description: Wallet-card UUID of the primary account, or null to clear the relationship

received_sign_up_bonus_on.description: Date the sign-up bonus was received in YYYY-MM-DD format

tool.name: manage_my_point_valuations
tool.title: Manage My Point Valuations
tool.description: Manage the current user's rewards program point valuations — how much the user values each rewards program's points.

id.description: Required for update and remove actions.

rewards_program_id.description: The topic UUID of the rewards program (required for action=add)

value_per_point.description: New point value in millionths of the major currency unit

tool.name: manage_my_rewards_statuses
tool.title: Manage My Rewards Statuses
tool.description: Manage the current user's loyalty tier / rewards program statuses (e.g. Gold, Platinum).

id.description: Required for update and remove actions.

rewards_program_status_id.description: The topic UUID of the rewards program status to add (required for action=add)

since.description: Date the status started in YYYY-MM-DD format

until.description: Date the status ends in YYYY-MM-DD format

tool.name: manage_my_spending
tool.title: Manage My Spending
tool.description: Manage the current user's spending by category.

id.description: Required for update and remove actions.

spending_category_id.description: The topic UUID of the spending category (required for action=add)

amount.description: New spending amount in integer minor units paired with its currency

tool.name: search_data_points
tool.title: Search Data Points
tool.description: Search for data point posts with optional JSONB filters. Use this to find approval rates, credit limits, and application outcomes for a specific card or topic.

topic_id.description: Filter by topic UUID or slug (e.g. a specific credit card or bank account topic)

credit_score_range.description: Filter by applicant credit score range

tool.name: search_posts
tool.title: Search Posts
tool.description: Search for posts using keyword (text_search_query or q), semantic (semantic_search_query), and similar-item signals. Use search for hybrid text+semantic search. Returns page_info.end_cursor; pass it as after to get the next page.

q.description: Keyword search. Same as GET /api/v1/posts q: matches post text and #hashtags.

search.description: Hybrid search shortcut. Same as setting both text_search_query and semantic_search_query to this value.

text_search_query.description: Text/keyword query for exact or lexical matching

semantic_search_query.description: Natural language query for semantic similarity search

similar_post_id.description: Find results similar to a post ID using embeddings

similar_topic_id.description: Find results similar to a topic ID using embeddings

similar_rss_feed_item_id.description: Find results similar to an RSS feed item UUID

after.description: Cursor from a previous result page_info.end_cursor, for the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page. Defaults to 25; values over 100 are clamped to 100.

sort.description: Sort order: new (most recent), best (highest voted), hot, relevance (search relevance; the default when searching), following_new

tool.name: search_topics
tool.title: Search Topics
tool.description: Search topics by name or slug (text_search_query or q), by meaning (semantic_search_query), and by similar-item signals. Use search for hybrid text+semantic search. Returns page_info.end_cursor; pass it as after to get the next page.

q.description: Keyword search. Same as GET /api/v1/topics q: matches topic names and slugs, and #hashtags.

search.description: Hybrid search shortcut. Same as setting both text_search_query and semantic_search_query to this value.

text_search_query.description: Text/keyword query for exact or lexical matching

semantic_search_query.description: Natural language query for semantic similarity search

similar_post_id.description: Find results similar to a post ID using embeddings

similar_topic_id.description: Find results similar to a topic ID using embeddings

similar_rss_feed_item_id.description: Find results similar to an RSS feed item UUID

after.description: Cursor from a previous result page_info.end_cursor, for the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page. Defaults to 25; values over 100 are clamped to 100.

tool.name: search_wikipedia
tool.title: Search Wikipedia
tool.description: Searches Wikipedia for articles by title. Returns a list of matching Wikipedia pages with their titles and page IDs. Use this to find relevant Wikipedia articles based on keywords or topics mentioned in the content.

query.description: The search query (e.g., "Artificial Intelligence", "Climate Change", "New York")

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5, max: 10)

tool.name: update_my_financial_profile
tool.title: Update My Financial Profile
tool.description: Update the current user's financial profile used for personalized data point comparisons. Only provide fields you want to update — omitted fields are unchanged.

currency.description: Currency shared by all of the user's monetary profile values

stated_income_range.description: Annual income range in integer minor units paired with its currency; for example, USD 75,000 to USD 100,000 is {"minimum":{"amount":7500000,"currency":"usd"},"maximum":{"amount":10000000,"currency":"usd"}}

total_credit_limit.description: Total credit limit across all cards in integer minor units paired with its currency; for example, USD 25,000 is {"amount":2500000,"currency":"usd"}
